Amber Chamber

Villa in Si Sunthon
HomeSaleAmber Chamber

Marketing images, mostly artist renders. Layouts and finishes may differ from the final product.

Project overview

Amber Chamber is a small hillside collection of private-pool villas in the Bang Jo area of Si Sunthon, Thalang, in northwest Phuket. The project comprises 3 and 4-bedroom homes of roughly 428 to 620 sqm built-up across the Essence, Serenity and Bliss designs. Listings describe it as under construction, with shared co-working, fitness and pet areas plus round-the-clock security. Unit counts, prices and handover timing differ between marketing sources.

Amber Chamber: key facts

  • Amber Chamber is a pool villa in Si Sunthon, Phuket, developed by 2 Thanwa Property Co., Ltd..
  • Units: 3–4 bedrooms, 428–620 sqm.
  • Construction status: under construction.
  • Ownership listed by sources: Leasehold.
  • Advertised starting price: ฿35,100,000.
  • Nearest beach: Bang Tao Beach (4.2 km, straight line).
  • Nearby, according to the project data: Bang Tao Beach (4.2 km, straight line); Thalang Hospital (3.4 km, straight line); Wattanapat Hospital Phuket (7.0 km, straight line); Makro (2.9 km, straight line).
